status: Local command-count arithmetic only; no live capacity, latency, billing or full-bootstrap acceptance.

continuation.production_signal: SDK LastEvaluatedKey retained privately with the returned array; no key is sent to the browser.
continuation.meaning: Another raw audience-feed query is indicated; this is not a count of authorized Finance rows.
continuation.idle: One existing protected request, no speculative follow-up when financeHasMore is false.
continuation.older_server: Missing hint stops after one page with continuation unknown.
continuation.checkpoint: Encrypted records, proof and independent Finance cursor commit per page before reading the next page.
stop_conditions: lock, stale access or controller replacement
continuation.not_covered: Historical bootstrap, complete retained-history coverage and other replay families remain open.

synthetic_one_audience_example.assumption: Dense 200-entry feed pages; allow one empty terminal query at a boundary. Not a bound on the five-year transaction import, which may create multiple events/audiences per transaction.
synthetic_one_audience_example.claim: Request count is not reduced; already-committed continuation pages can run within the same foreground cycle.

sensitivity_qualifications: Ten visible online unlocked hours/day, including two Finance hours; not twelve hours. Two clients remain an unconfirmed sensitivity.
A continuously full backlog is a stress upper scenario, not the household monthly forecast.
Focus/manual calls, other UI snapshots, per-audience queries, source dependency checks, Lambda duration and writes require separate accounting.
No fivefold multiplier applies to idle polls. Additional catch-up usage is not accepted as fitting an old allowance without measurement.
$6.50 combined monthly ceiling including 30% contingency remains unchanged; migration unrun.
